verdict.rationale: The evidence documents account verification, account and routing number retrieval, Tokenized Account Numbers and microdeposits. These are building blocks a developer could use for ACH money movement elsewhere. Nothing shows MX itself offering a pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product, and no live geographies for one are stated.

support.subject: As a developer, I can initiate a bank payment from a connected account — a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product with its live geographies stated honestly
